acceptanceCriteria: OIF-V0 lists the closed set of accepted decision-heading variants, and the reader accepts exactly that set.
An ADR whose heading is outside the set still refuses with the existing code; tests cover each accepted variant and one near-miss.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 as the follow-up to owner question 3 on OIF-V0 / decision 0386 (PR #190), answered yes. The ADR intent form reads only the exact decision heading. Corvint and Beamfall ADRs also use `## Decision`, `## Decisions` and numbered forms such as `## 2. Decisions`. Accept a closed, enumerated list of variants; anything else still refuses visibly. Do this after #190 merges.
title: ocm: accept a closed list of ADR decision-heading variants in the ADR intent form
